verdict.rationale: The portal's info site publishes notices of service unavailability ("Indisponibilidade de serviços no Portal") for the customs and IEC/ISV systems. That is a thin sign that availability windows are announced ahead of time, but nothing shows standing operating hours, per-day limits or session timeouts being disclosed before a user starts filing. Missing for 10: published operating-hours windows for tax filing flows, any disclosure of per-day submission limits, published session-timeout duration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
